Legal

Privacy notice.

Legacy Search Advisory Private Limited uses information you submit to assess and respond to your enquiry and manage related discussions.

What you share

We collect your contact details, organisation, stakeholder type and the preferences you enter. Optional fields let you add a LinkedIn profile or short note. Please keep confidential documents and third-party personal details for a later, agreed exchange.

How the form works

Submitting the form records your consent, submission time, source page and any campaign or referral label. Our database provider processes this information on our behalf. Short-lived rate-limit records use keyed identifiers to help prevent spam. Technical providers may process connection information when serving the site.

Access and follow-up

Access to the enquiry queue is limited to authorised personnel. We use your details for this conversation and related follow-up. A form submission does not enrol you in marketing emails. We retain enquiries while needed for the discussion, follow-up and applicable recordkeeping.

Your choices

You can ask to access, correct or delete your information, withdraw consent to future contact or raise a privacy concern. Call +91 8008712898 and quote your reference if available. We may ask you to verify your identity before acting on a request.
